venue.name: Creative Escape Art Studio
venue.description: Creative Escape is an art studio inside Nanaimo North Town Centre on Rutherford Road, run by the artist Robyn Foster with two other instructors. It runs registered classes in acrylic painting, drawing, clay sculpture and mixed media for adults, teens, youth from age 8, children from age 6, and a parent and child class from age 4. The about page says the studio also runs customised birthday parties and programs for groups and private events. Nothing on the site says the studio travels out to schools or daycares.
venue.seasonal_notes: Classes are published as short seasonal series. The listings on the site in September 2026 run on set dates in September and October 2026, and the studio says to contact it to sign up.
venue.price_year_or_season: Fall 2026 classes, dated September and October 2026

programs.name: Parent and Child Art
programs.description: A weekly family class for ages 4 to 7 in which a parent takes part alongside the child. The project changes each week and includes clay, painting and printmaking on the studio's large printing press. The listing on the site runs on Saturdays from 17 to 31 October 2026, 10:00 to 11:00, and the price of $84.00 per child covers the three weeks.
programs.what_children_do: Work at the studio tables beside a grown up on a different project each week, handling clay, paint and the studio's big printing press.
programs.our_note: This is the only class the studio publishes for children under 6, and an adult has to stay and join in. It is sold as a three week Saturday series rather than a single visit, so it fits a family outing better than a group booking.
programs.practical_summary: The studio is inside Nanaimo North Town Centre. Nothing is published about washrooms, lunch space, parking or how many children can come, so those are worth asking when you call.
programs.evidence: Saturdays |  Oct 17-Oct 31 | 10:00-11:00 | $84.00 per child per 3 weeks

programs.name: Monster Mashup
programs.description: A three week children's class for ages 6 to 10 with surprise projects, including 3D painting and monsters, and games and prizes on the last day. The studio asks children to dress for mess. The listing runs on Tuesdays from 13 to 27 October 2026 with a 16:00 and a 17:30 sitting, and the $120 covers the three classes.
programs.what_children_do: Paint and build monster projects at the studio tables across three weekly sessions, and play games on the last one.
programs.our_note: Both sittings start after 16:00, so this is an after school class rather than something a group can come to in the day. If you want a daytime session, ask the studio about the group and private bookings it mentions on its about page.
programs.practical_summary: The studio is inside Nanaimo North Town Centre. Washrooms, lunch space, parking and the number of children per class are not published, so ask before you count on a place.

programs.name: Group and private event art session
programs.description: The about page says the studio runs programs for groups and private events, and customised birthday parties at the studio where the children pick from a range of art projects and each takes a finished piece home. No ages, prices, group sizes, dates or notice period are published for these.
programs.what_children_do: Choose an art project from the range the studio offers and make it, with a finished piece to take home.
programs.our_note: All the site says is that groups, private events and birthday parties can be booked. Price, ages and how many children fit are all unpublished, so this is a phone call before it is a plan.
programs.practical_summary: Nothing practical is published for group bookings, not price, not group size, not washrooms or lunch space. Expect to settle all of it on the phone.
programs.evidence: The studio also offers programs for groups and private events.

Four white cups holding coloured pencils, paintbrushes, markers and sticks of chalk.
A green monster figure with blue fur hair, orange horns and pink cheeks.

gaps: The site never mentions schools, daycares, preschools or visits to a classroom. All of its classes are listed at the studio address, so we have recorded the programs as ones you travel to, and we have not answered whether school or daycare groups are hosted.
Group and private event bookings: no price, no ages, no group size, no notice period and no dates are published. Only one sentence on the about page says they exist.
Birthday parties are mentioned on the about page with no price, age range or party size.

Washrooms, lunch space, rain backup, stroller and wheelchair access and parking: nothing published. The studio is inside Nanaimo North Town Centre but the site does not describe the space or the mall facilities.
Opening hours are not published. The contact page only says to stop by the studio anytime.
Class sizes are not published for any class.

The family class page says $84.00 per child per 3 weeks. The children's class page shows only $120/3 Classes with no wording about who the price covers. We recorded it as a price for one child because these are individual class registrations, but it is worth confirming.
One adult class shows a price plus GST. The children's class pages say nothing about tax, so we have not recorded whether tax is included on those.

RETRIEVAL NOTE: the class list is built in JavaScript and a plain fetch returns only the adult classes tab. The children's, youth, teen and family listings were read in a browser after clicking through the tabs.
The photographs on this site carry no alt text and no captions. The three we recorded were opened in a browser and looked at before their descriptions were written.
No photograph on the site shows the studio entrance or the way in from the mall.
The site calls itself Creative Escape Art Studio in the footer and Creative Escape Art Programs in the about text. The tracker uses the second name.
